title: antennaria aprica var. aureola
intro: Antennaria aprica var. aureola, commonly known as Golden Ragwort, is a flowering plant species within the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions attributed to Golden Ragwort include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Golden Ragwort include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
